notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update: Fixes, Balance & QoL Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and thank you for all the amazing feedback and support during the festival! ❤️

I’ve just updated the Agecraft demo to make the experience smoother and more fun.




🔹 What’s new:




Fixed several noticeable bugs.

Adjusted the balance for a smoother start.

Added extra helper elements to improve control and orientation.

Implemented a few QoL improvements - small changes that make the game more comfortable to play.






✨ What is QoL?




“Quality of Life” improvements are little tweaks that don’t change the core gameplay, but make everything feel better. Examples include:



clearer tooltips;

improved hotkeys;

quicker access to essential actions;

better visibility for resources.





🎮 Try out the updated demo and let us know what you think!

👉 And if you haven’t yet, don’t forget to add Agecraft to your Wishlist - it really helps a lot 🏗️
